title: FORRÓ BASIC STEPS for BEGINNERS | Learn, practice & DANCE ALONG

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: Rafael speaks directly to the camera in English with Portuguese subtitles, explaining concepts clearly and breaking down routines step by step. He emphasizes weight transfer, balance, and rhythm, guiding students through repetitions with a friendly and encouraging tone.

lesson_structure.note: Rafael introduces the forró basic steps tutorial for beginners.
Rafael explains the four routines and the structure of the practice.
Dance routine 1 with side basic 1-1, 2-2, back basic, and front & back.
Dance routine 2 with faster pacing of the same sequence.

cues: focus on your balance and your weight transfer
be as precise as you can with the music

steps_taught.name: Lateral em dois tempos com três passos
steps_taught.description: Side basic in two beats with three steps.

what_works: Clear time stamps for routines provided on screen
Step-by-step breakdown with back and front views
Progressive tempo from slow practice to dance along
what_hinders: Spoken explanation is in English while song lyrics or titles are in Portuguese

evidence_segments.observation: Rafael stands in a room with hardwood floors, gesturing with his hands while explaining the structure of the four routines.

extraction.distinctive_method: Structuring the tutorial into four distinct routines that repeat the same fundamental steps at varying tempos and with inverted camera perspectives.
